title: MCP server skeleton: stdio + Streamable HTTP, auth, read-only, once-per-session write confirm
description: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk server, MCP_TRANSPORT=stdio|http, bearer MCP_AUTH_TOKEN for http, LENDLORD_READ_ONLY disables write tools. Write confirmation ONCE PER SESSION (user decision 2026-10-15): first write call without confirm:true is rejected with a summary; once confirmed, all writes in that session (stdio process or Mcp-Session-Id) proceed. LENDLORD_AUTO_CONFIRM=true skips it. Structured errors.
notes: Implemented + tested offline (in-memory MCP tests, stdio smoke). Close once wuh.1 live login verified.

title: Core client: encryption, login, session, request helpers
description: Node crypto aes-256-ctr encrypt/decrypt (ivHex:cipherHex). Auto-discover key from live bundle (runtime chunk map -> regex), cache to disk. Login via POST /api/loginUser (enc), cookie jar, 2FA via /api/twoFA/verify (TOTP secret), re-login on 401. Typed get/post/put/patch/delete + multipart upload. Vitest with recorded fixtures (sanitised).
notes: Done: crypto (unit tests), key auto-discovery verified LIVE against app.lendlord.io, cookie session, re-login, TOTP (RFC vector test), fake-server client tests. Remaining: live login verification (needs user's .env creds) - login body assumed {email,password,keepMeLoggedIn}.
close_reason: Live login verified (body {email,password,keepMeLoggedIn}); live read tests pass

title: lendlord-mcp v1: AI-managed Lendlord account via MCP
description: TypeScript MCP server (stdio + Streamable HTTP) wrapping Lendlord's private encrypted API. See README.md and docs/api.md.

title: Confirm document upload multipart encoding of entities[] and delete path params
description: Capture POST /api/documents and DELETE /api/documents/:a/:b/:c from the UI.

title: Write tools: property CRUD, document upload/link/rename/delete, communications, tenants
description: Before each tool: capture real request body in the web app (Playwright) to confirm field names. Upload accepts path/URL/base64 and entities[].
notes: User concern: writes must be verified. Each write tool requires: (1) UI capture of real request, (2) live round-trip against a throwaway test property created+deleted, (3) opt-in LENDLORD_LIVE_TESTS=1 integration test. Uploads consume free-plan quota (numberOfFilesUploadsLeft) - ask user before upload tests.

title: Email to property filing: parse .eml, match property, file email + attachments
description: match_email_to_property (score postcode/address/tenant/policy/cert numbers), file_email_to_property, file_email_auto with confidence threshold. Mailbox-agnostic.
